subject: Post-demo: production-ready model shortlist & pilot plan
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Leah Park <lpark@peregrine.ai>, Samir Khan <samir.khan@peregrine.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 5 Nov 2026 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: Post-demo: production-ready model shortlist & pilot plan

Thanks again for the time today — great discussion and helpful context on the 3 demo flows (extractions from analyst notes, automated summarization, and insight generation). Per our ask, I wanted to summarize the model candidates we recommend for a short pilot, the rationale, and the concrete next steps so we can run the evaluation cadence you requested.

High-level recommended shortlist (prioritized for a 4-week pilot):
1) redwood-lite-8b-q4 (cost-first) — expected latency ~60-90ms/token at Peregrine's typical 512-token workset; lowest per-token cost, strong for concise extraction tasks.
2) open-instruct-13b-fp16 (balanced) — noticeably better instruction-following; latency ~110-140ms/token, moderate cost, fewer hallucinations on our tests.
3) rwd-llama-70b-8bit (quality-first) — best quality for nuanced insight generation; higher cost and variance in tail latency; recommend only for the insight-generation flow where quality is critical.

Why these three:
- Coverage: they span the cost/latency/quality frontier so we can map tradeoffs to your SLA targets.
- Quantization profile: 8b-q4 gives large cost wins with consistent latency; 70b-8bit preserves quality but requires more tail capacity planning.
- Safety/PII: initial spot checks show similar redactability across all three; full PII sweep planned during evaluation.

Artifacts attached / links:
- Peregrine benchmark summary (attached as peregrine_benchmark_summary.csv) — includes token-level cost estimates for 100k/1M token runs and P95 latencies from our synthetic workload.
- Prompt set (drive link + attached prompt_set_v1.jsonl) — 1k seeded prompts split across the three flows + 200 stratified stress cases.
- Benchmarks: https://redwood.run/benchmarks/peregrine-2026-v1

Quality regression concerns and mitigations:
- Risk: Small prompts with long context (notes + metadata) increase chance of hallucination on smaller models.
  Mitigation: we will instrument reference-based QA + a hallucination detector and run a 200-sample human eval (label quality & hallucination) before any canary.
- Risk: Tokenization mismatch on some of your proprietary shorthand.
  Mitigation: provide a short tokenizer mapping script (we'll include as part of the eval bundle) and run a 50-sample mismatch check.

Proposed evaluation plan (4 weeks):
- Week 0 (this week): agree on pilot scope, sample distribution, and success metrics (accuracy thresholds for extraction, MeanOpinionScore target for insights).
- Week 1: automated runs across the 1k prompt set for all three models + basic perf profiling.
- Week 2: human evaluation (200 samples) + safety/PII sweep.
- Week 3: canary rollout plan for the selected model, production latency profile, final cost estimate.

Immediate asks for Peregrine:
- Confirm which flow(s) you want prioritized in the 4-week pilot (extraction / summarization / insights).
- Share a representative sample of 100 production examples (can be redacted) OR confirm we should use the provided seed set.
- Any hard budget or latency SLA we must respect for the pilot?

I'll coordinate the evaluation runs with Karthik (tech lead) and Ben can scope the pricing. If helpful I can send a one-page Mutual Action Plan with owners and dates — attached draft (mutual_action_plan.md).

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
Sr. Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
T: +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: peregrine_benchmark_summary.csv, prompt_set_v1.jsonl, mutual_action_plan.md

Subject: Re: Post-demo: production-ready model shortlist & pilot plan

Thanks Marissa — this is very helpful. Quick clarifications from my side: 

1) Latency numbers — are those P50 or P95? For our UI we care about P95 under 500ms for 512-token completions.
2) Data retention & PII — we have a strict retention policy and will need to confirm where logs live for Hosted vs. Private. Is Private deployment an option for the pilot?
3) Cost — rough ballpark monthly cost for the 70b-8bit model at ~10M tokens/month?

We'd like the pilot to prioritize extraction and summarization first, with a smaller bucket for insights (we want to validate quality improvement before committing to 70b). We'll share the 100 example payloads by end of day Monday.

Also looping Samir for procurement questions — Samir, can you confirm internal budget timing and whether we should expect a PO?

On the retention/PII question, I'll attach the internal data handling summary separately — we may need to bring security folks in after these initial runs.

Best,
Leah

Marissa / Karthik — forwarding Leah's reply and note on procurement. I've started a quick pricing sketch (attached pricing_estimate_peregrine.xlsx) with three bands aligned to the shortlist:
- Band A (8b-q4 pilot): low monthly run cost estimate, supports Hosted API easily.
- Band B (13b-fp16): medium. Good balance of cost and quality; recommended default for the summarization/extraction flows.
- Band C (70b-8bit): much larger reserve capacity needed; recommend Dedicated or Private for predictable latency and data residency.

Next internal asks:
- Karthik: can you confirm the eval infra needs (GPU hours, any special kernel toggles) so I can be precise on consumption?

Thanks Leah — great, appreciate the prioritization. Quick confirmations and owners so we have a clear plan: 

Mutual Action Plan (high level):
- Marissa (owner): finalize pilot scope doc and mutual_action_plan.md by EOD Friday.
- Karthik (owner): spin up eval runners and run Week 1 automated tests; estimate: 12 GPU hours for the full 1k seed set across the three models (will confirm by EOD).
- Ben (owner): finalize pricing bands and Private deployment lead time; deliver pricing_estimate_peregrine.xlsx and a short PO checklist.
- Peregrine (owner): provide 100 sample payloads (redacted) by Monday EOD and confirm any hard SLA/budget limits.

Answers to Leah's questions: 
- Latency numbers in the attached summary are P95; the 70b-8bit P95 has higher variance — we'll capture p50/p95/p99 in the automated report.
- Private deployment: yes, available. For a 70b pilot we recommend Private or Dedicated capacity to hit predictable P95s; lead time for Private (entire onboarding + networking) is ~3-4 weeks. For an initial pilot, we can run the 70b in Hosted but with reservation windows and a fallback to 13b if latency balloons.
- Cost ballpark for 70b-8bit at ~10M tokens/month is in the attached pricing_estimate_peregrine.xlsx (Band C) — Ben will send the final numbers.

Next steps:
1) Peregrine to share sample payloads by Monday.
2) We (Karthik + Marissa) will run Week 1 automated profiling for the agreed-on flows.
3) Ben to send PO checklist & pricing by early next week.
4) If Peregrine wants Private on day 1 for 70b, we start security kickoff simultaneously (Ben + Marissa to schedule).

I'll schedule a 30-minute sync for Tue 11/10 10am PT to review Week 1 outputs unless you prefer another time.

Thanks all — excited to get this running.
